jobs.title: Law School Admissions Consultant
jobs.description: About Inspira Education Inspira Education Group is one of the fastest-growing edtech startups in the US. We started with a simple mission to democratize access to high-quality coaching so that every student in the world has an equal opportunity to access the best opportunities. As the world’s leading network of top admissions coaches in medical, legal, business, and college studies, we’re building software and services in one place—disrupting long-entrenched application processes with products and experiences that strive to provide an equal platform for candidates from diverse backgrounds worldwide. As one of the fastest-growing edtech firms in the world, we are backed by some of the leading venture capital firms and investors in the world, including Zeev Ventures, Quiet Capital, Craft Ventures and Jeff Fluhr (Founder of Stubhub). The Role We are looking for a Law School Admissions Consultant with a deep understanding of the law school admissions process. If you're passionate about mentoring and guiding future law students through law school applications, this could be the perfect fit. In this role, you'll work closely with students to build law school application strategies, refine their personal statements and application essays, prepare for law school interviews, and support them in choosing the right law schools and programs. You'll be a trusted coach throughout the law school admissions process, helping students present their strongest selves and gain admission to their top-choice law schools. This is a part-time, remote, 1099 contract role that can be based anywhere in the United States or Canada. jobs.description: Company TransPerfect Language & Cultural Training is part of the TransPerfect solutions, the world’s largest language service and technology solutions provider for global businesses with offices in more than 100 cities around the globe. Position details TransPerfect is currently looking for an English language trainer in Paris (and nearby area), to join our team of language professionals. As an English language trainer with TransPerfect, you will deliver language classes to our clients from a variety of sectors and cultural backgrounds.
